tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from CoreWeave AI infrastructure services, dedicated GPU clusters, and high-performance network orchestration ($3,661.0M in Q3 2026, beating Street consensus $3,540.79M by +$120.21M / +3.40%).
tooltip_definitions.Active Deployed Power: Operational energised capacity across CoreWeave data center campuses hosting production GPU workloads, surpassing 1.7 GW in Q3 2026 after adding 200+ MW in the quarter.
tooltip_definitions.Contracted Power Pipeline: Total contracted power pipeline growing to over 4.6 GW across diversified global utility partners, including over 1.3 GW international footprint across India, Indonesia, and Spain.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$1.27 in Q3 2026 based on 559M weighted average shares, beating Street consensus (-$1.55) by $0.28 (+18.06%).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Income: GAAP operating income turned positive to $207.0M in Q3 2026 (5.65% operating margin) compared to -$49.0M in Q2 2026 and -$144.0M in Q1 2026, marking an essential operational inflection point.
tooltip_definitions.Gross Profit: GAAP gross profit of $2,478.0M in Q3 2026 (67.69% gross margin) compared to $1,696.0M in Q2 2026 and $995.85M in Q3 2025 (+148.8% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash provided by operating activities reached $1,975.0M in Q3 2026, surging sequentially from $679.0M in Q2 2026 on accelerated contract milestone payments and AI cluster billings.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized internal-use software, of $9,441.0M in Q3 2026, funding Nvidia Blackwell B200 and H200 GPU infrastructure.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow ($1,975.0M) minus capital expenditures ($9,441.0M) equals reported negative free cash flow of -$7,466.0M in Q3 2026 due to historic infrastructure investment.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity compensation expense of $160.0M in Q3 2026 ($478.0M for 9M 2026), reflecting disciplined equity grant controls.
tooltip_definitions.Finance Lease Obligations: Principal payments on finance leases and long-term data center equipment obligations, which stood at $0.0M in Q3 2026 after substantial payoffs in Q2.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Comprehensive economic cash flow subtracting CapEx ($9,441.0M) and SBC ($160.0M) from OCF ($1,975.0M), totaling -$7,626.0M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Customer Prepayments and Deposits: Customer cash prepayments and reservation deposits expected to total approximately $9.0B over the next three months, providing non-dilutive capex liquidity.
tooltip_definitions.Revenue Backlog: Remaining performance obligations and long-term contracted AI compute commitments from leading AI frontier labs, hyperscalers, and enterprise clients.
tooltip_definitions.After-Hours Reaction: CRWV shares surged +7.90% to $52.58 in after-hours trading as CoreWeave beat Q3 revenue, turned operating profitable, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B.
tooltip_definitions.Blackwell B200 Deployments: CoreWeave's prioritized allocation and initial commercial cluster turn-ups of Nvidia's next-generation Blackwell architecture across North American data centers.
tooltip_definitions.Exit-2026 ARR Guidance: Management increased exit-2026 annualized run-rate revenue guidance to $20.0B - $21.0B, reflecting massive forward visibility on committed GPU instances.
tooltip_definitions.Liquid Cash & Balance Sheet: Cash, restricted cash, and marketable securities totaling $5,589.0M at September 30, 2026, anchored by $56.8B in deployed net property and equipment.
